arc: God-Level System: Supreme Martial - Arc 1: Awakening of the Useless
topic: A modern young man dies and transmigrates to a cultivation world as the discarded son of a declining clan. His new body is crippled, his dantian blocked. System awakens - but claims to be useless
moral: tier-0 only." First test: survive the clan's discard ritual. System secretly records everything
column5: storing "trash" skills that gradually reveal hidden potential as the host accumulates enough "worthless" techniques to form a God-tier foundation.

id: True power doesn't announce itself - it hides in plain sight until the world must kneel.

arc: God-Level System: Supreme Martial - Arc 2: Law Devouring Flame
topic: The System's trash" skills activate during a forbidden art backfire - devouring a rival's Fire Dao law grants the MC the [Primordial Devouring Flame] thought impossible for his realm. He enters the outer sect assessment
moral: not as a weakling but as a flame cultivator that elders whisper about in terrified tones. The clan's prodigies are stunned - his flame burns brighter than their heirlooms

id: Power that cannot be measured by mortal standards eventually reshapes the battlefield entirely.

arc: God-Level System: Supreme Martial - Arc 3: Secret Realm Invasion
topic: A secret realm opens at the clan's estate - entry requires a minimum cultivation base. The clan's elite block the crippled MC, but his Devouring Flame repels the realm's initial trial, proving his trash" system is anything but. Inside the realm
moral: he faces ancient guardians that feed on cultivation - his System devours their laws instead
column5: converting enemy cultivation into his own growth. He returns not just stronger
column6: but with a realm-altering secret: the System can harvest laws from any realm entity.

id: The weakest vessel can become the deadliest harbor for devoured power.

arc: God-Level System: Supreme Martial - Arc 4: Celestial Sect Recruitment
topic: The clan's decline accelerates - forces move to seize remaining assets. The Celestial Sect passes through, recruiting talents. The MC's Devouring Flame catches a Senior Elder's attention - not for his cultivation, but for the System's impossible potential. He's offered a place, but refusal means the clan's enemies will target him. He accepts, leaving behind a clan that will never recover from losing their trash" son to celestial heights.

id: Opportunity is a trap when refusal means certain death at the hands of those you spurned.

arc: God-Level System: Supreme Martial - Arc 5: Law Fragment Harvest
topic: Years later, the MC is a disciple at the Celestial Sect. His trash" System rating never improves
moral: but his comprehension does - he's harvesting law fragments from missions
column5: combining them into something new. A sect war erupts - the MC's faction is outnumbered
column6: but his God-tier law combination creates a battlefield advantage that shifts the entire conflict. Enemies realize too late that his "useless" system is the war's true weapon.

id: What appears limited from the outside may be limitless from within.

arc: God-Level System: Supreme Martial - Arc 6: God-Adjacent Ascension
topic: The ultimate confrontation - a God-level entity from beyond the heavens targets the MC's sect. The System finally reaches its true state: [Supreme Martial God] - not just a system, but a cosmic anchor. The MC ascends beyond mortal constraints, his body a vessel for God-level law itself. He turns the invading God's own power against it, proving the System's origin was never trash" - it was a seed planted in the wrong soil
moral: waiting for the right host to bloom.

id: True systems don't grant power - they reveal the power already sleeping within.
